preferences.data.title: Recovery and recent files
preferences.data.note: Recovery snapshots are stored outside the project file. Reviewing them shows every saved project and instance.
preferences.data.autosaveEnabled: Write recovery snapshots while I edit
preferences.data.autosaveNote: Autosave writes recovery snapshots that can be restored after a crash. It never saves the project file. Turning it off or pausing stops only the periodic snapshots; structural checkpoints are still written before page and source changes. A longer interval writes less often and puts more recent work at risk.
preferences.data.autosaveStateOn: Autosave is on. It writes at most one snapshot every {seconds} seconds after a change.
preferences.data.autosaveStatePaused: Autosave is paused for this session. It starts again the next time you open GridScalr.
preferences.data.autosaveStateOff: Autosave is off. Structural checkpoints are still written until you turn it on again.
preferences.data.backupNote: GridScalr keeps rolling backups of the open project in its own app data folder. They never sit beside the project file, never enter recent files and are never included in a project package.
preferences.data.backupRetentionNote: The new limit is applied on the next successful save. Deleting backups never touches the project file or its drawings.
preferences.data.backupRetentionSaved: Keeping {count} backups after the next save.

recoveryCenter.intro: Every autosave and structural checkpoint GridScalr stores locally, grouped by project and app instance. Nothing is restored automatically; restore or delete only the record you select.
recoveryCenter.autosaveExplanation: An autosave is work you have not saved to the project file yet. It is written after a change while a project is open and is removed when you save that session.
recoveryCenter.checkpointExplanation: A checkpoint is a labelled snapshot written before a structural action such as deleting a page or replacing a source drawing. It stays until it is deleted or rotated out.
recoveryCenter.budgetNote: The newest autosave and the newest checkpoint of every project are always kept. Older records rotate out oldest first when the count or the byte budget is reached.
